gloss: organizing committee member; executive committee member

definitions.gloss: organizing committee member; executive committee member
definitions.explanation: A member of a committee responsible for planning and carrying out an event, festival, or project. Common in schools, universities, and community organizations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{文化祭|ぶんかさい}→文化祭：05589_bunkasai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{実行|じっこう}{委員|いいん}になった。
examples.english: I became a member of the cultural festival organizing committee.

examples.japanese: {実行|じっこう}{委員|いいん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: The organizing committee held a meeting.

examples.japanese: ⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{実行|じっこう}{委員|いいん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}められた→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: The event preparations were led by the organizing committee members.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{実行|じっこう}→実行：03274_jikkou⟧ (execution/implementation) and ⟦{委員|いいん}→委員：01708_iin⟧ (committee member). In Japanese schools and universities, students often serve on organizing committees for events like ⟦{文化祭|ぶんかさい}→文化祭：05589_bunkasai⟧ (school festivals), ⟦{体育祭|たいいくさい}→体育祭：21233_taiikusai⟧ (sports days), and ⟦{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}→卒業式：05584_sotsugyoushiki⟧ (graduation ceremonies).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実行|じっこう}{委員|いいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become an organizing committee member
- {実行|じっこう}{委員|いいん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to serve as an organizing committee member
- {実行|じっこう}{委員|いいん}{長|ちょう}: head of the organizing committee
- {実行|じっこう}{委員|いいん}{会|かい}: organizing committee (the body/organization)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{委員|いいん}→委員：01708_iin⟧: committee member — a broader term for any committee member
- ⟦{幹事|かんじ}→幹事：16378_kanji⟧: organizer, secretary — typically for social gatherings like parties
